create_SimpleTokenizer: create a SimpleTokenizer instance with a custom BPE vocabulary path for text tokenization
run_SimpleTokenizer_call: run the SimpleTokenizer __call__ method to encode text strings into fixed-length token tensors
test_SimpleTokenizer_encode: test the SimpleTokenizer encode method to convert cleaned text into a list of BPE token IDs
review_SimpleTokenizer_decode: review the SimpleTokenizer decode method to convert a list of token IDs back into readable text
summarize_SimpleTokenizer_bpe: summarize the SimpleTokenizer bpe method that applies byte-pair encoding to split tokens
